$comment: 10 federal authorities relevant to defense-industry-base regulated AI / cybersecurity / export-control / CUI obligations. Seed dataset; verifiable against authority URLs.

authorities.name: Department of Defense, Office of the Chief Information Officer
authorities.scope: DFARS cybersecurity clauses (252.204-7012, -7019, -7020, -7021), CDI safeguarding, cyber incident reporting policy
primary_obligations: report cyber incidents within 72 hours to dibnet.dod.mil
authorities.ai_specific_position_as_of_seed: Issued DoD Responsible AI Strategy + Implementation Pathway (2022) + CDAO oversight; expanding CMMC-adjacent AI governance under 2026 DFARS sweep.

authorities.name: The Cyber AB (CMMC Accreditation Body)
authorities.scope: CMMC ecosystem oversight — C3PAOs, RPOs, assessors, registered practitioners
primary_obligations: accredit C3PAOs that issue CMMC L2/L3 certifications
maintain Code of Professional Conduct for assessors
authorities.ai_specific_position_as_of_seed: AI tools used in assessment evidence collection fall under same assessor confidentiality + integrity controls as human-generated evidence.

authorities.name: Defense Industrial Base Cybersecurity Assessment Center (DCMA)
authorities.scope: Government-led CMMC L3 assessments, DoD-conducted NIST 800-171 medium/high confidence assessments
authorities.ai_specific_position_as_of_seed: Assesses contractor self-reported scores in SPRS; growing focus on AI tools touching CUI during 2026 assessment cycles.

authorities.name: Directorate of Defense Trade Controls (State Department)
authorities.scope: ITAR administration (22 CFR 120-130), US Munitions List, defense-services export licensing
primary_obligations: license export of USML items + technical data + defense services
authorities.ai_specific_position_as_of_seed: Interim guidance treats AI-generated technical data on USML items as subject to ITAR; foreign-person AI access requires deemed-export authorization analysis.

authorities.name: Bureau of Industry and Security (Commerce Department)
authorities.scope: EAR administration (15 CFR 730-774), Commerce Control List, dual-use export controls
rulemaking_authority_basis: Export Control Reform Act of 2018 (50 USC 4801)
primary_obligations: screen against Entity List + Denied Persons List + Unverified List
authorities.ai_specific_position_as_of_seed: October 2023 + 2024 controls on AI chips + frontier-model weights for certain destinations; ongoing rulemaking on cloud-AI compute (Section 4.2 of EO 14110 successor).

authorities.name: National Institute of Standards and Technology
authorities.scope: SP 800-171 (CUI protection), SP 800-172 (enhanced security), NIST AI RMF, NIST SP 800-218A (SSDF for AI)
primary_obligations: maintain AI RMF + Generative AI Profile
host CUI Registry coordination with NARA-ISOO
authorities.ai_specific_position_as_of_seed: AI RMF + Generative AI Profile (NIST AI 600-1) widely cited in DFARS rulemaking + 7012 modernization; SP 800-218A defines secure development for AI systems.

authorities.name: General Services Administration
authorities.scope: FAR procurement policy (52.204-21 basic safeguarding), GSA Schedules + IT-70, FedRAMP joint authorization with DoD/DHS
primary_obligations: administer FAR clauses on prime contracts
vet AI tools in GSA Multiple Award Schedule
FedRAMP authorization pathway for AI services
authorities.ai_specific_position_as_of_seed: Generative AI specific procurement guidance published 2024; AI tools on GSA Schedule subject to enhanced disclosure + FedRAMP requirements at Moderate+.

authorities.name: Defense Contract Management Agency
authorities.scope: Contract administration on DoD contracts; supplier risk + cybersecurity oversight downstream of DFARS
authorities.ai_specific_position_as_of_seed: AI tools used in supplier risk analytics fall under same data-handling rules as supplier records (FOUO/CUI as applicable).

authorities.name: Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency
authorities.scope: NISPOM administration (32 CFR 117), personnel security clearance investigations, facility clearances, FCL/SCIF oversight
authorities.ai_specific_position_as_of_seed: AI tools at cleared facilities subject to NISPOM 8-100-series IT controls + IS-1 system security plan requirements; classified-environment AI use heavily restricted.

authorities.name: National Archives and Records Administration — Information Security Oversight Office
authorities.scope: Executive Agent for Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) program (32 CFR 2002); E.O. 13556 implementation
primary_obligations: oversee agency CUI implementation across federal government
authorities.ai_specific_position_as_of_seed: CUI Notice 2020-04 establishes baseline CUI handling; AI tools processing CUI must apply category-specific safeguarding from CUI Registry markings.
